name: mobopinions-survey-light
description: Build, target, launch and analyse consumer surveys with real panel respondents from your AI assistant: 71 tools behind a remote Streamable HTTP server with OAuth 2.1 sign-in (no API key).

http.description: Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint; sign in with a surveys.mobopinions.com account through OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration + PKCE)

examples.title: Validate a product idea
examples.description: Create a short survey, target an audience and price the fieldwork
examples.prompt: Create a 6-question survey on oat-milk purchase drivers for 200 UK adults aged 25-45, add a grocery-shopper screener, and tell me the price before launching.

examples.title: Read results
examples.description: Summarise what respondents said once fieldwork is complete
examples.prompt: Summarise the results of my oat-milk survey by age group and export the responses to Excel.
